name: Joseph Hernandez
occupation: Venture capital investor (Blue Water Venture Partners)

supports: Cutting Wall Street fees paid by the pension fund
Market-driven investments that create jobs in New York
positions.quote: Invest in New York by strengthening pension performance, cutting excessive Wall Street fees, and pursuing disciplined, market-driven investments that can create jobs and economic growth across the state.
positions.impact: The state pension fund, which the Comptroller manages, would likely shift some money toward investments in New York companies and lower-fee managers. Pension benefits themselves are set by law and wouldn't change.

opposes: Continued growth in state taxes and spending
positions.quote: New Yorkers pay some of the highest taxes in the country, while Albany continues to spend more every year.

source.title: Issues – Joseph Hernandez for Comptroller (campaign site)

positions.impact: Expect audits aimed at cutting state spending. The Comptroller audits and reports on spending but doesn't set taxes or pass the budget.
